notable_absence.finding: Viewing team information is explicitly stated to require no elevated role at all - open to every organization member - unlike create/edit/delete, which all gate on Organization Owner: "All members of an organization can view team information." This is a deliberate, docs-stated absence of a role gate, not a silent omission.

cross_component_finding: The promoted capella-role:* registry (organization-owner, project-owner, project-data-writer) is a subset, not the whole org-role catalog: this page names a fourth role, Organization Member (the default role of "My First Team"), and links out to full 'organization roles' and 'project roles' catalogs (organization-user-roles.md, project-roles.md) that this batch does not mine directly. Separately, and more significantly for the batch hypothesis: this page's per-provider instructions for entering an SSO group into the **SSO Groups** field are NOT uniformly parameterized. Five providers (Okta, Ping, CyberArk, Google Workspace, OneLogin) all say to enter 'the group name as it's shown' in the IdP. Azure AD (Entra ID) is the one exception: "Enter the group's object ID into the **SSO Groups** text area instead of the group's name." This is exactly the kind of hidden inconsistency the batch hypothesis anticipated - it is a real functional difference (a different field format Capella expects), not just cosmetic, and it is documented only here, not on sso-entra-id.md itself, which never mentions the group-mapping value format at all.
